### Easy to Use

The Kojo API was designed from the ground up to make it easy to integrate with Kojo. Our documentation will get you up and running quickly, allowing you to build new tools to manage your Kojo account.

![Focus on What Matters](https://docs.kojo.tech/img/undraw_docusaurus_tree.svg)

### Focus on What Matters

Our API is designed to be simple and consistent, allowing you to focus on developing your app. Our engineering team is here to help if you have questions!

![Powered by GraphQL](https://docs.kojo.tech/img/undraw_docusaurus_react.svg)

### Powered by GraphQL

GraphQL is a next generation query language for building powerful APIs. Learn how Kojo uses GraphQL and how you can get started.
